## Checks

- [ ] `npm run typecheck` and `npm test` pass
- [ ] A behaviour change has a test; a new diagnostic has a test pinning its **message**
- [ ] No new spelling for a value that already has one (see CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated if the surface moved
